orphanDialog: narrator|The Red Pen clicks itself shut, rolls off the podium, and hops away down the hall toward the second grade room.
narrator|BRRRRRING. One bell. Right on time. Then silence. The good kind.
narrator|BRRRRRING. From inside the school. Then again. Then a little one: brring?
narrator|For two hours, Amy talks to thirty parents. Grace hands out cookies. Rose tells everybody the pen had glasses. Tom stacks chairs and nods calmly.
narrator|Nara lets out the biggest sigh a dog has ever sighed. Then she trots home.
narrator|Nara sits down on Tom’s feet. If he can't move, he can't leave.
narrator|Tom wiggles free. "A week. Maybe two. You guard the porch."
grump|A man in a long coat gave me a gold coin for it.
grump|He said if the clocks never agree, conference night never has to start, and then nobody ever goes home.
grump|I did. I made the bells and the clocks wrong so that everybody would be late. Late is late. Points off.
